name: NAC™: Assembling Package
description:
You might be saying, "So I've just purchased this thing, now what?" We have just the solution for you!

The §5§nAssembling Package§r is the most important upgrade to the NAC™ platform, allowing for the creation of circuits with your processed components. This isn't just another assembler - it's the most important machine you'll ever own.

Provide the Nanochip Assembly Matrix with a Vacuum Conveyor Input (sold separately) containing the necessary components, and all the circuits you have ever wanted will be yours!

§oPower costs may be high. The NAC™ offers a guarantee that modules will not powerfail, but offers no guarantees on your existing power network.
